## ACTINOMYCES SPP.
Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See
diagnosis/syndrome section for more information.
## Preferred treatment
Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h [R]
< OR >
Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h [R]
< OR >
Amoxicillin 500 mg PO q8h [R]
## Alternative for severe beta-lactam allergy
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Doxycycline 100 mg IV q12h [DI]
< OR >
Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h [DI]
